rules.rule_context:
From Veltex Data Protection Office, Partner Operations Channel:

Support data collected under Article 6(1)(b) for contract performance sits within a closed purpose boundary. Reuse for sales targeting or lead scoring sits outside that boundary unless a fresh legal basis attaches. The test is purpose at collection versus purpose at reuse: where the original purpose was operational support and no marketing consent was obtained, subsequent processing for sales targeting requires either (a) valid consent under Article 6(1)(a) or Article 7, or (b) anonymization to the point where the data no longer relates to an identified or identifiable natural person under Recital 26. Data still tagged to identifiable partners, accounts, or contacts from a support context cannot flow to lead-scoring or similar commercial targeting pipelines on the original Article 6(1)(b) basis alone. Re-tagging or reclassification after collection does not cure a purpose limitation breach where the data was not collected for that purpose and no compatible further processing assessment applies.
